title: Choose sampling, evidence assembly, citations, and output constraints so a generated result can be checked and safely consumed by the next component

questions.prompt:
A generator extracts backup-retention periods using only supplied documents. Its output feeds a service that automatically deletes expired backups. Source S1 describes backup encryption but gives no retention period. The generator returns `{"retention_days":30,"source_id":"S1"}`. The response is complete, matches the required schema, and names an existing source.

Which handling is justified before the deletion service consumes this result?
options: Accept the result because schema validation confirms that the retention value meets the output contract.
Regenerate at zero temperature and accept the result if the same retention value appears again.
Return an explicit insufficient-evidence result because the cited source does not support the retention value.
Accept the result because the source identifier resolves to a document about the relevant backups.

rubric.point: Selects explicit abstention because the retention value lacks source support despite valid structure and a real citation.

questions.model: Return an explicit insufficient-evidence result because the cited source does not support the retention value.
